strings.name: Lewis Hamilton
strings.summary: Hamilton progressed from karting to Formula 1 with McLaren, Mercedes and Ferrari. Seven drivers’ championships and enduring win and pole-position records made him a central figure in racing. As F1’s first Black driver, he also increased public discussion of inclusion.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. Selected milestones; competitions, affiliations and records refer to their cited dates, not an exhaustive match log.
strings.influence.rationale: Seven F1 titles and record wins accompany advocacy for diversity and public issues in motorsport.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Seven world titles
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Won in 2008, then added six drivers’ championships with Mercedes.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Breaking participation barriers
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: As F1’s first Black driver, raised the visibility of diversity in racing.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: First Ferrari Grand Prix win
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Won the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix, his first main-race victory for Ferrari.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Started with Ferrari
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Ended his long Mercedes spell and partnered Charles Leclerc.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Seventh championship
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Equalled Michael Schumacher’s seven drivers’ titles.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Joined Mercedes
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Left McLaren and began the most successful phase of his title-winning career.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: First F1 title
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Secured the decisive position on the final lap of the Brazilian season finale.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: F1 debut season
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Won four Grands Prix with McLaren and finished runner-up in the championship.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: GP2 champion
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Won the major junior single-seater series before moving into F1.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: McLaren development support
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Joined its young-driver programme while progressing through karting and single-seaters.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Stevenage
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Grew up in England and began karting as a child.
